title: Reading lab: Mark 10:46–52
subtitle: Track repeated address, command, and response.
overview: Bartimaeus’ scene uses repetition, participles, direct speech, and an imperative. Repeated words help you follow the scene’s focus and response.
Keep the crowd’s speech, Jesus’ command, and Bartimaeus’ answer distinct as three voices in the narrative.

items.grc: ὁ δὲ πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἔκραζεν· υἱὲ Δαυίδ, ἐλέησόν με.
items.en: But he was crying out all the more, “Son of David, have mercy on me.”

items.grc: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀνέβλεψεν καὶ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ.
items.en: And immediately he received sight and was following him on the way.
